chapter_mission: Deliver the Midpoint viscerally, not informationally. The group enters a node Veraine deliberately collapsed as a field test — complete de-structuring. Ben's moral intuition goes silent. Desh's environmental wrongness crosses into undeniable. Torin smiles. Ben flips from reactive to proactive.
chapter_turn: Ben stops reading the threat and starts setting the terms. The wrongness is not something happening to the group; it is something a person deliberately engineered and signed. The midpoint is an experience, not a revelation — the reader has to feel the Force-as-handrail disappear.

scene_plan.purpose: Approach and entry. The Steady Returns lands at the breach zone (Kolven). Desh's chrono-drift reading, temperature inconsistencies, wrong-growing vegetation. The group crosses the boundary into the de-structured zone. Ben's Force-sense reaches for the handrail and finds nothing.

Full experience. The Force present but formless — no direction, no light/dark distinction, no moral feedback loop. Visceral for Ben. Kael calm in a way that frightens Sera. Torin walks into the worst of it and smiles. Desh's grief-without-an-object hits. R08 lands — experientially, not expositionally.

On the way out — back in structured Force, but changed. The group names what Veraine has been doing: this was a test. She is engineering, not studying. Ben stops deferring and sets the new agenda — pace, priority, route. The seal lurch from Ch12 is now a direction of travel, and Ben is choosing it.

relationship_turns.to: shared witness — the breach zone is the first thing Kael and the Force-trained group experience on equivalent terms (the Force is not trustworthy for any of them here)

relationship_turns.from: philosophical tension — archive disagreements, sharp edges
relationship_turns.to: irreconcilable difference — Torin's smile in the breach is unforgettable for Sera; she stops defending him in her own head
verified partners — Desh's non-Force-sensitive confirmation of the wrongness validates Ben's perception and closes the loop of doubt Ben has been carrying since Ch1

exit_vector: The Steady Returns lifts away from Kolven with the wrongness now mapped as enemy action. Ben is no longer asking what happened; he is deciding what to do. Every pressure dial crosses into red. Next stop: the third act.
notes: The most important experiential chapter in the book and the hardest to write. Use full de-structuring sensory vocabulary from concept_seed.force_mechanics.sensory_vocabulary.full_de_structuring — the Force as formless pressure, the missing handrail, the silent moral feedback. Desh's grief-without-an-object must land on a non-Force-sensitive reader without mysticism. Torin's smile is the pivot — do not overexplain; trust the reader to feel it. Voice: Stover-dense interior allowed in s2 specifically; Zahn-tight elsewhere. Anti-pattern: do not intellectualise the experience. Absolutely no metaphor like 'it was as if the Force had—'. The Force does not have 'as if'; it has 'is' or 'is not.' Maetha's warning from Ch12 should echo in Ben's head at least once.
